title: Pocketwire Personal Account Deposit Benefit: Charity Deposit Lift in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards values donated points at a higher rate when the linked Pocketwire Personal Account received direct deposits within the last month.

## Clause

The charity deposit lift is 0.06 cents per point when the direct deposits received by the linked personal account within the last month total at least 5000 USD, 0.03 cents per point when they total at least the direct-deposit lift threshold, 500.00 USD on every Pocketwire Rewards tier, but less than 5000 USD, and nothing when they total less than 500.00 USD.

The lift is added to the charity rate per point before the rate is applied to the points donated.

The records read are the direct deposit entries on the ledger of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account. A date lies within the last month when it is later than the same calendar day one month before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Deposit bands

| Direct deposits within the last month | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|
| 5000 USD or more | 0.06 |
| 500 USD or more, less than 5000 USD | 0.03 |
| less than 500 USD | nothing |

## Boundary cases

- Deposits of exactly 5000.00 USD: 0.06; 4999.99 USD: 0.03.
- Deposits of exactly 500.00 USD: 0.03; 499.99 USD: nothing.
- Handled on 15 July 2025, a direct deposit dated 16 June 2025 is within the last month; one dated 15 June 2025 is not.
